# fishing.nice.okinawa

Okinawa Fishing Charter is an English-first static website for fishing trip enquiries in Okinawa. The site presents beginner shared boat fishing experiences, private fishing charters, GT fishing, tuna and multi-species trips, amberjack live bait fishing, jigging, trolling, bottom fishing and remote island charter enquiries.

The service is booking coordination and translation support only. Actual trip operation, safety decisions, weather and sea-condition calls are handled by the captain and vessel. The site does not process payment online.

Contact and booking:
- Email: info@nice.okinawa
- WhatsApp: +81 70-8952-3968
- WeChat: OkinawaOnline
- Booking form: https://fishing.nice.okinawa/#contact

Known service areas and departure ports:
- Chatan American Village Port / Chatan Hamagawa Port
- Kadena Fishing Port
- Uruma Awase Port
- Ishigaki Island and Miyako Island by direct enquiry
